project.title: Metagenomic survey of a hot spring microbial mat
project.description: A survey of the microbial community of a hot spring mat, sampled monthly for two years. Sequencing was combined with an in-house enrichment protocol that does not fit any of the listed methods.

relevance.other: Baseline data for a regional conservation programme.

target.description: Environmental mat communities sampled across a thermal gradient; neither a single isolate nor a defined multispecies set.
target.method_description: In-house enrichment followed by long-read sequencing.

data_type_descriptions.eOther: Per-sample community composition tables derived from the reads.
